description: We are a 3 person team with complementary backgrounds in geospatial technologies, AI, and data science. One member studies Applied Geomatics ingeneering at UNSTIM, while the other two are pursuing training in Digitalisation and Data Science at SCITI . United by our experience in NOAI, we are participating in NASA Space Apps 2026 with FireWatch Africa, a geospatial tool that harmonizes MODIS and VIIRS satellite observations to analyze fire activity and historical patterns, starting with Benin.
